# Summary
Part of the batch of 13 blog topic ideas drafted from the 49-post review on June 24-25 and saved to `blog-drafts\` (per the handoff: drafted, not published). Source: `blog-drafts\pre-purchase-sewer-inspection-phoenix.md`. Each draft carries a focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta, slug, internal link list, image alt ideas and external sources.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** pre purchase sewer inspection phoenix.
- **Status:** draft only; not in the July 21 live blog inventory, and no later publish record in this folder.
- Buyer guide: what a sewer inspection finds, cost and timing. The idea was later done as the sewer scope inspection guide (Oct 13), without prices.
